title: Nikitha Suresh stays calm in 50th Ohio Junior Girls Championship - NewsBreak
text:
By BVM Sportsdesk, ,
1 days ago Nikitha Suresh clinched the 50th Ohio Junior Girls Championship at Marion Country Club, finishing with a total score of 1-under 215. After shooting a tournament-best 68 in round two, Suresh maintained her lead to win by two strokes over last year's runner-up, Elisabeth Coleman. Despite the pressure from her playing partners, Suresh's calm demeanor and strategic putting were key to her performance. Coleman finished second with a total of 1-over-par 217, while defending champion Meadow Tian placed third at 3-over 219. Suresh's victory earned her a spot in the upcoming U.S. Girls Junior Championship. Read full article
